description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerLog class, which is an ORM entity representing logs related to performance tracking in a Human Resource Management system. It includes properties for log details, comments, status, achievement, timestamps, and associations with performance tracker, employee, and user entities.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLog
classes.description: An ORM entity class representing a performance tracker log entry with properties for log information, status, achievement, timestamps, and relations to other performance-related entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the log entry.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the log entry.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Retrieves the log message or detail.

methods.name: setLog
methods.description: Sets the log message or detail.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves the comment associated with the log.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment for the log.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of the log entry (e.g., deleted or not).

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the log entry.

methods.name: getAchievement
methods.description: Gets the achievement description related to the log.

methods.name: setAchievement
methods.description: Sets the achievement description.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date when the log was added.

methods.name: setAddedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the log was added.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Retrieves the last modified date of the log.

methods.name: setModifiedDate
methods.description: Sets the last modified date of the log.

methods.name: getPerformanceTracker
methods.description: Gets the associated performance tracker entity.

methods.name: setPerformanceTracker
methods.description: Associates a performance tracker entity.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves the employee associated with this log.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the employee for this log entry.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Gets the user who made or is associated with this log.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a user with this log entry.
